checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Exactly three separate square logo images

must.why: All three spell it correctly. Logo 1 has MOSS in the first line and &Mile in the second, which is legible.

must.item: Small symbol alongside or above name
must.why: Each has a symbol: leaf wheel above, milestone left, chainring above.
Leaf wheel, milestone with road, and chainring sprout. The layouts differ too.

must.item: Green and black on plain white, no mockups/labels
must.why: Plain off-white backgrounds, green and black only, no labels.

exact_text.read_as: Moss & Mile (logo 1: 'Moss' / '& Mile' on two lines)

faults.what: Logo 1: the wheel is broken and partly hidden behind the leaf. It is not the thin black circle with spokes-as-veins that was described. The text is cramped and off-balance.
Logo 2: the milestone looks like a black bin or tombstone, the moss is small, and the road lines are thin. The lockup is wide and sits left in the frame, so it is small in the square.
Logo 3: the chainring is tiny and detailed against very large text, so the symbol is weak. The sprout is a bright lime green that differs from the other greens.
The greens are inconsistent across the three, and the chat description does not match logos 1 and 3 exactly.

summary: Three separate square logos with correct 'Moss & Mile' text and clearly different symbol ideas, on white in green and black; the symbols are somewhat rough and unevenly sized, and the first two don't match the descriptions well.
